metaDescription: Order custom bottle lanyard badges with a bottle holder attachment. Perfect for events and hydration on the go. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Custom bottle lanyard badges combine the convenience of a badge holder with a built-in bottle carrier, making them ideal for trade shows, corporate events, and outdoor team activities. Unlike standard lanyards, this style keeps a water bottle or drink within easy reach while keeping identification visible. Choose from durable nylon, woven polyester, or recycled materials, and add your logo with screen printing or full-color dye sublimation. Available with breakaway safety features for added security.
